update_text: Cursed Abyss floors, Void Essence and MYTHIC gear are here! Update now!
title: MYTHIC GEAR & CURSED ABYSS
message: New in 1.3: from Abyss floor 30, every 5th floor is cursed (Shielded, Vampiric, Swift or Thorns). Floor 30+ drops Void Essence, double on cursed floors. Merge 3 Legendaries + Void Essence into a MYTHIC item! Trait items can now be merged too, and the leaderboard tracks your deepest floor each week. Thanks for playing!
